name: Evocom Berhad
overview: Evocom Berhad 于2026年在马来西亚交易所 ACE 市场完成首次公开募股（IPO），发行113,907,000股新股。公司业务线包括灵活人力供应服务和网络支持服务，但今年公告中未披露各业务板块的具体运营变化。
overview_en: Evocom Berhad completed its initial public offering (IPO) on the ACE Market of Bursa Malaysia Securities Berhad in 2026, issuing 113,907,000 new ordinary shares. The company's business lines include flexible staffing services and network support services, but no specific operational changes for each segment were disclosed in this year's announcements.

segments.name: 集团
segments.note: 公司今年完成 IPO，在 ACE 市场上市。
segments.note_en: The company completed its IPO and listed on the ACE Market this year.
